organization: Kyoto University (Takahashi group; Yokoyama, Kashimoto, Takahashi et al.)
processor: Yb optical-tweezer array (minimally destructive coherent-excitation imaging)
notes: Minimally destructive fast imaging of single atoms in an optical tweezer array via deterministic coherent excitation. Achieves 99.89% discrimination (readout) fidelity with 98.80% survival in 17.6 microseconds, with reduced heating rates vs incoherent approaches. RELEVANCE 2/5: readout-fidelity advance for neutral-atom (Yb) tweezer arrays; relevant to mid-circuit measurement quality for the neutral-atom MERA path. Frontier for readout/discrimination fidelity in this window. Does not change physics anchors.
